latest_news.headline: Nuclear facilities struck - Arak heavy water + Ardakan yellowcake plant hit
latest_news.text: IRNA confirms Shahid Khondab Heavy Water Complex (Arak) and Ardakan yellowcake facility struck. No radiation, no casualties. IRGC vows retaliation: 'equation will no longer be eye for an eye.' Israel claims responsibility.

latest_news.headline: Trump extends power plant deadline to April 6 - 2nd extension
latest_news.text: Trump extends Iran Hormuz deadline to April 6. Iran asked for 7 days, Trump gave 10. Iran denies negotiations. Stocks fall 5th straight week. Witkoff: 'strong signs peace is possible.'

latest_news.headline: Hormuz toll booth formalized - IRGC vetting, yuan payments, parliament legislation
latest_news.text: AP confirms IRGC 'toll booth' regime in Strait of Hormuz. Ships vetted, escorted via Larak Island route. At least 2 vessels paid tolls in yuan. Parliament pursuing legislation to formalize fees. 90% traffic drop.

latest_news.headline: Israel army exhausted - IDF Chief warns 'brink of collapse'
latest_news.text: IDF Chief of Staff warns army is 'raising 10 red flags' and on brink of collapse after years of regional forever wars. Major strain from multi-front operations.

latest_news.headline: Kuwait ports hit - China BRI project damaged
latest_news.text: Kuwait reports material damage to Shuwaikh Port and Mubarak Al Kabeer Port (under construction as part of China's Belt and Road Initiative). First Chinese-affiliated project damaged in war.
